description: Laboratory OpenID Federation OP automatic-registration plan. Alpha suite plan; no external federation membership or certification is implied.
_notes: Generate local private fixture keys using go run ./cmd/conformance-federation-keys; create-plans.sh injects them without committing them.
Explicit operator configuration required: federation.conformance_trust_anchor must match SUITE_URL + /test/a/clavex-openid-federation-op/trust-anchor.
This override applies only to the conformance tenant with conformance_mode=true. Production tenant trust remains unchanged.
The suite must be reachable from the backend with verified TLS. No real federation membership is assumed.
